purpose: Allow a currently unresolved one-for-many personnel replacement to be studied as a bounded, role-weighted committee without inventing workload percentages or changing live Graham numbers.
governingRules: The unavailable player's governed healthy value remains unchanged.
Every committee member must be a currently verified replacement candidate for the affected role and must have a locked Walters value in the player registry.
Do not assign arbitrary workload percentages. Exact role shares require explicit current football evidence.
When exact shares are unresolved, a registry-only replacement envelope may be calculated from the minimum and maximum locked values among the verified active committee members.
The envelope is an uncertainty interval, not permission to choose its midpoint or whichever endpoint is convenient.
A shadow fair interval may be computed only from the existing independent Graham fair and the existing personnel sign convention.

If both ends of the exact shadow interval round to the same half-point display, that display may be marked interval-invariant in shadow testing only; the exact fair remains unresolved inside the interval.

Committee complementarity, role specialization, blocking/receiving fit, opponent-specific effects and clusters are not assumed to be captured by the registry-only envelope. They require separate football evidence and must not be double-counted.
Market lines, prices, movement and betting percentages are forbidden inputs.

committeeMath.exactShareFormula: effectiveReplacementValue = sum(roleShare_i * lockedReplacementValue_i), with roleShare_i >= 0 and sum(roleShare_i) = 1, only when role shares are evidence-supported.
committeeMath.teamLossEnvelope: teamLossMin = healthyValue - replacementValueMax; teamLossMax = healthyValue - replacementValueMin.
committeeMath.teamContributionDeltaEnvelope: replacementValue - healthyValue at each envelope endpoint.

reopenOn: practice-squad elevation or roster transaction affecting the committee
specific role specialization evidence that invalidates the registry-only envelope
